statement: The pinned Reasonix engine runs a bounded tool-round loop that captures a cache prefix shape, streams a provider turn, commits only a clean terminal attempt, then either finalizes or dispatches the committed tool calls before the next round.

display_text.zh-CN: 固定版本的 Reasonix engine 运行有边界的 tool-round loop：先捕获 cache prefix shape，再流式采样 provider，仅提交 clean terminal attempt，随后 finalize 或分派已提交的 tool calls。
display_text.en: The pinned Reasonix engine runs a bounded tool-round loop that captures a cache prefix shape, streams a provider turn, commits only a clean terminal attempt, then either finalizes or dispatches the committed tool calls before the next round.

notes: This is a source-level engine claim. It does not establish live DeepSeek or other provider behavior.
